text: I don't know if I'm bein silly but my grandbaby Marcus, he 2, been hot all evening, temp was 38.6. He keep coverin his eyes, he don't want the lamp on, he cryin say the light hurt. And he won't look down at his belly, I tried to get him to look at his toy on his lap and he just won't bend his head forward, he keep it real stiff. His skin and his lips look the regular colour tho, he ain't pale or nothin. His mama at work so it's just me. Should I be worried or is I'm makin too much of it
